On the sixteenth, the Three Primes descend. On the twenty-seventh, the descent of the Dipper. On the twenty-eighth, the human spirit is in the dark; those who offend suffer grave illness. So it is every day. On the thirtieth, the Kitchen Lord of Destiny memorializes; those who offend have one year cut from their lives. So it is every day. If the month is short, keep the abstinence on the twenty-ninth.

On the first day of the second month, those who offend have their years seized; so it is every month. It is also the birthday of the True Lord Liu. On the third, the birthday of Emperor Wenchang; to offend brings the cutting of emolument and the seizing of years. It is also the assembly of all the spirits in the capital, and the descent of the Dipper. On the fifteenth, the birthday of the Old Lord; those who offend have their years seized. On the eighteenth, the anniversary of the death of the Supreme Teacher Confucius; those who offend have their emolument cut and their years seized. On the nineteenth, the birthday of Bodhisattva Guanyin; those who offend have their years seized. On the twenty-first, the birthday of Samantabhadra. On the twenty-seventh, the descent of the Dipper. On the twenty-eighth, as before. On the thirtieth, as before.

On the first day of the third month, as before. On the third, the birthday of the Primordial Emperor; those who offend have their years seized. It is also the descent of the Dipper. On the ninth, the ox ghosts and spirits come forth; those who offend conceive evil fetuses. On the fifteenth, the birthday of the Emperor of the Vast Heaven, and also the birthday of the Primordial Altar; those who offend have their years seized. On the sixteenth, the birthday of Cundi; those who offend have their years seized. On the eighteenth, the birthday of the Great Emperor of the Central Marchmount. On the nineteenth, the birthday of the Sun Lord of the Solar Palace; those who offend have their emolument cut and their years seized. On the twenty-seventh, the descent of the Dipper. On the twenty-eighth, the birthday of the Great Emperor of the Eastern Marchmount; those who offend have their years seized. It is also the birthday of Cangjie, the Former Sage. On the thirtieth, as before.

On the first day of the fourth month, as before. On the third, the descent of the Dipper. On the fourth, the birthday of Manjushri, and the day when all the spirits transform the good; those who offend lose their voice. On the eighth, the birthday of Sakyamuni Buddha; those who offend have their years seized. It is also the descent of the youths of good and evil; those who offend die by blood. On the fourteenth, the birthday of Patriarch Lü. On the fifteenth, those who offend have their years seized; so it is every month. On the twenty-seventh, the descent of the Dipper. On the twenty-eighth, as before. On the thirtieth, as before.

On the first day of the fifth month, as before. On the third, the descent of the Dipper. On the fifth, called the Earthly La, when the Five Emperors examine the offices of living men; those who offend have their emolument cut and their years seized. On the eleventh, the birthday of the City God of the capital. On the thirteenth, the birthday of Emperor Guan; those who offend have their years seized. The fifth, sixth, seventh, fifteenth, sixteenth, seventeenth, twenty-fifth, twenty-sixth, and twenty-seventh are called the nine poisonous days; those who offend die young. And if on the fifteenth, in the hour of the rat, one offends, man and woman will both die within three years. The sixteenth, moreover, is the day on which Heaven and earth and the ten thousand things are created and transformed, and is most to be avoided. Also the twenty-seventh, the descent of the Dipper. On the twenty-eighth, as before. On the thirtieth, as before.

On the first day of the sixth month, as before. On the third, the descent of the Dipper. On the fifteenth, as before. On the nineteenth, the attainment of the Way by Guanyin. On the twenty-third, the birthday of the Fire God. On the twenty-fourth, the birthday of the Thunder Ancestor. On the twenty-seventh, the descent of the Dipper. On the twenty-eighth, as before. On the thirtieth, as before.

On the first day of the seventh month, as before. On the third, the descent of the Dipper. On the seventh, called the La of the Way and its Virtue, and also the Middle Assembly. On the thirteenth, the birthday of Mahasthamaprapta. On the fifteenth, the birthday of the Earthly Official of the Middle Prime; those who offend have their years seized. On the nineteenth, the Great Year. On the twenty-second, the birthday of the God of Wealth who increases blessing. On the twenty-seventh, the descent of the Dipper. On the twenty-eighth, as before. On the thirtieth, as before.

On the first day of the eighth month, as before. On the third, the birthday of the Kitchen Lord of Destiny, and also the birthday of the Northern Dipper and the descent of the Dipper; those who offend have their years seized. On the tenth, the birthday of the Great Emperor of the Northern Marchmount. On the fifteenth, as before, and also the court of the Moon; burn incense and keep vigil through the night. On the twenty-seventh, the birthday of the Supreme Teacher Confucius; those who offend have their emolument cut and their years seized. It is also the descent of the Dipper. On the twenty-eighth, as before. On the thirtieth, as before.
